_comment: Revision R2.6, R2.8, R3.4 + LR intercept: discovery oracle under LR with a penalized (logreg, published) and an unpenalized intercept (logreg_lbfgs), RF and GBDT, on 288 base states (seeds 0-5) x 4 rounds, sharded; plus full campaigns on the same states (all strategies, all learners). Copy results/campaign/oracle/*.csv (and the merged seeds 3-5 LR files) into results/revision/oracle/ first: finished (learner, state, round) triples are skipped. Run: rare-al run --config configs/eswa/rev_oracle.json --only oracle oracle_campaign The observability analysis (--only observability, Table S-c5) uses oracle.classifier = logreg_lbfgs.
